aliases.4.1: the same procedures; those marked since 5.0 are not in MPI 4.1

tags.coll: collective: every process of the communicator (group, window or file) must call it
tags.nb: nonblocking: returns a request to complete with MPI_Wait or MPI_Test
tags.pers: persistent: creates a request to start with MPI_Start and complete with MPI_Wait or MPI_Test
tags.ierr: in mpi_f08, ierror is optional (in mpi and mpif.h it is required)
tags.lc: mpi_f08 also has a large-count form, with integer(MPI_COUNT_KIND) counts

sections.entries: procedures, callback interfaces and predefined callbacks
sections.types: the derived types of mpi_f08 that the arguments use: the handle types and MPI_Status

fields.k: kind, when it is not s
fields.c: category, as Open MPI files it
fields.a: arguments of the mpi_f08 binding (or of `use mpi`, when f08 is 0): [name, intent, type, flags]
fields.o: 0: no page in the Open MPI 5.0.x documentation (link to its main branch instead)
fields.std: page numbers of the definition in the MPI 5.0 and 4.1 standards (null: none found)
fields.since: the MPI version that added it, when that is 5.0
fields.see: the procedure that takes this callback

typeFields.c: public components of the derived type: [name, type] (a handle has one, MPI_VAL, the integer handle of mpi)
typeFields.old: the type `use mpi` and mpif.h declare it with
typeFields.std: pages of the section that describes it in the MPI 5.0 and 4.1 standards (Opaque Objects; Return Status)

mpi_f08.note: Fortran 2008 bindings; ierror is optional; handles are derived types (type(MPI_Comm))

mpif.h.note: deprecated since MPI 4.1; use mpi_f08 (or mpi)

MPI_Session_get_info.s: Returns an info object containing the hints of an MPI Session

MPI_Session_get_nth_pset.s: Query runtime for name of the nth process set

MPI_Session_get_num_psets.s: Query runtime for number of available process sets

MPI_Session_get_pset_info.s: Returns an info object containing properties of a specific process set

MPI_Session_iflush_buffer.s: Wait till all messages currently in the session-specific buffer of the calling MPI process have been transmitted.

MPI_Session_set_errhandler.s: Attaches a new error handler to a session.

MPI_Sizeof.s: Returns the size, in bytes, of the given type

MPI_Ssend_init.s: Builds a handle for a synchronous send.

MPI_Start.s: Initiates a communication using a persistent request handle.

MPI_Status_f082f.s: Translates a Fortran 2008 status into a Fortran INTEGER-style status, or vice versa.

MPI_Status_f2f08.s: Translates a Fortran 2008 status into a Fortran INTEGER-style status, or vice versa.

MPI_Status_get_error.s: Retrieves the MPI_ERROR field from status.

MPI_Status_get_source.s: Retrieves the MPI_SOURCE field from status.

MPI_Status_get_tag.s: Retrieves the MPI_TAG field from status.

MPI_Status_set_cancelled.s: Sets status to indicate a request has been canceled.

MPI_Status_set_elements.s: Modifies opaque part of status to allow MPI_Get_elements to return count.

MPI_Status_set_elements_x.s: Modifies opaque part of status to allow MPI_Get_elements to return count.

MPI_Status_set_error.s: Sets the MPI_ERROR field on status.

MPI_Status_set_source.s: Sets the MPI_SOURCE field on status.

MPI_Status_set_tag.s: Sets the MPI_TAG field on status.

MPI_Test.s: Tests for the completion of a specific send or receive.

MPI_Test_cancelled.s: Tests whether a request was canceled.

MPI_Testall.s: Tests for the completion of all previously initiated communications in a list.

MPI_Testany.s: Tests for completion of any one previously initiated communication in a list.

MPI_Testsome.s: Tests for completion of one or more previously initiated communications in a list.

MPI_Topo_test.s: Determines the type of topology (if any) associated with a communicator.

MPI_Type_copy_attr_function.s: Interface of the routine that copies a datatype attribute when the datatype is duplicated.

MPI_Type_create_f90_complex.s: Returns a bounded MPI complex datatype

MPI_Type_create_f90_integer.s: Returns a bounded MPI integer datatype

MPI_Type_create_f90_real.s: Returns a bounded MPI real datatype

MPI_Type_create_hindexed.s: Creates an indexed datatype with offsets in bytes.

MPI_Type_create_hindexed_block.s: Creates an indexed data type with the same block length for all blocks.

MPI_Type_create_hvector.s: Creates a vector (strided) data type with offset in bytes.

MPI_Type_create_indexed_block.s: Creates an indexed data type with the same block length for all blocks.

MPI_Type_create_keyval.s: Generates a new attribute key for caching on data types.

MPI_Type_create_resized.s: Returns a new data type with new extent and upper and lower bounds.

MPI_Type_create_subarray.s: Creates a data type describing an n-dimensional subarray of an n-dimensional array.

MPI_Type_delete_attr.s: Deletes a datatype-caching attribute value associated with a key.

MPI_Type_delete_attr_function.s: Interface of the routine that deletes a datatype attribute.

MPI_Type_dup.s: Duplicates a data type with associated key values.

MPI_TYPE_DUP_FN.s: Predefined copy callback: the attribute value is copied to the new datatype.

MPI_Type_free_keyval.s: Frees a previously created type key value.

MPI_Type_get_attr.s: Returns the attribute associated with a data type.

MPI_Type_get_contents.s: Returns information about arguments used in creation of a data type.

MPI_Type_get_envelope.s: Returns information about input arguments associated with a data type.

MPI_Type_get_extent.s: Returns the lower bound and extent of a data type.

MPI_Type_get_extent_x.s: Returns the lower bound and extent of a data type.

MPI_Type_get_name.s: Gets the name of a data type.

MPI_Type_get_true_extent.s: Returns the true lower bound and extent of a data type's corresponding typemap, ignoring MPI_UB and MPI_LB markers.

MPI_Type_get_true_extent_x.s: Returns the true lower bound and extent of a data type's corresponding typemap, ignoring MPI_UB and MPI_LB markers.

MPI_Type_get_value_index.s: Returns a reference (handle) to one of the predefined datatypes suitable for the use with MPI_MINLOC and MPI_MAXLOC if…

MPI_Type_match_size.s: Returns an MPI datatype of a given type and size

MPI_TYPE_NULL_COPY_FN.s: Predefined copy callback: the attribute is not copied to the new datatype.

MPI_TYPE_NULL_DELETE_FN.s: Predefined delete callback that does nothing.

MPI_Type_set_attr.s: Sets a key value/attribute pair to a data type.

MPI_Type_set_name.s: Sets the name of a data type.

MPI_Type_size.s: Returns the number of bytes occupied by entries in a data type.

MPI_Type_size_x.s: Returns the number of bytes occupied by entries in a data type.

MPI_Unpack.s: Unpacks a datatype into contiguous memory.

MPI_Unpack_external.s: Reads data from a portable format

MPI_User_function.s: Interface of a user-defined reduction operation.

MPI_Wait.s: Waits for an MPI send or receive to complete.

MPI_Waitall.s: Waits for all given communications to complete.

MPI_Waitany.s: Waits for any specified send or receive to complete.

MPI_Waitsome.s: Waits for some given communications to complete.

MPI_Win_allocate.s: One-sided MPI call that allocates memory and returns a window object for RMA operations.

MPI_Win_allocate_shared.s: One-sided MPI call that allocates shared memory and returns a window object for RMA operations.

MPI_Win_attach.s: One-sided MPI call that attaches / detaches a memory region to / from a window object for RMA operations.

MPI_Win_call_errhandler.s: Passes the supplied error code to the error handler assigned to a window

MPI_Win_complete.s: Completes an RMA access epoch on win started by a call to MPI_Win_start

MPI_Win_copy_attr_function.s: Interface of the routine that copies a window attribute.

MPI_Win_create.s: One-sided MPI call that returns a window object for RMA operations.

MPI_Win_create_dynamic.s: One-sided MPI call that returns a window object for RMA operations.

MPI_Win_create_errhandler.s: Creates an error handler for a window.

MPI_Win_create_keyval.s: Creates a keyval for a window.

MPI_Win_delete_attr.s: Deletes an attribute from a window.

MPI_Win_delete_attr_function.s: Interface of the routine that deletes a window attribute.

MPI_Win_detach.s: One-sided MPI call that attaches / detaches a memory region to / from a window object for RMA operations.

MPI_WIN_DUP_FN.s: Predefined copy callback: the attribute value is copied to the new window.

MPI_Win_errhandler_function.s: Interface of a user-defined error handler for windows.

MPI_Win_fence.s: Synchronizes RMA calls on a window.

MPI_Win_flush.s: Complete all outstanding RMA operations at both the origin and the target

MPI_Win_flush_all.s: Complete all outstanding RMA operations at both the origin and the target

MPI_Win_flush_local.s: Complete all outstanding RMA operations at both the origin

MPI_Win_flush_local_all.s: Complete all outstanding RMA operations at both the origin

MPI_Win_free.s: Frees the window object and returns a null handle.

MPI_Win_get_attr.s: Obtains the value of a window attribute.

MPI_Win_get_errhandler.s: Retrieves the error handler currently associated with a window.

MPI_Win_get_group.s: Returns a duplicate of the group of the communicator used to create the window.

MPI_Win_get_name.s: Obtains the name of a window.

MPI_Win_lock.s: Starts an RMA access epoch locking access to a particular rank.

MPI_Win_lock_all.s: Starts an RMA access epoch locking access to all processes in the window

MPI_WIN_NULL_COPY_FN.s: Predefined copy callback: the attribute is not copied to the new window.

MPI_WIN_NULL_DELETE_FN.s: Predefined delete callback that does nothing.

MPI_Win_post.s: Starts an RMA exposure epoch for the local window associated with win

MPI_Win_set_attr.s: Sets the value of a window attribute.

MPI_Win_set_errhandler.s: Attaches a new error handler to a window.

MPI_Win_set_name.s: Sets the name of a window.

MPI_Win_start.s: Starts an RMA access epoch for win

MPI_Win_sync.s: Synchronize the private and public copies of the window

MPI_Win_test.s: Attempts to complete an RMA exposure epoch; a nonblocking version of MPI_Win_wait

MPI_Win_unlock.s: Completes an RMA access epoch started by a call to MPI_Win_lock.

MPI_Win_unlock_all.s: Completes an RMA access epoch started by a call to MPI_Win_lock_all.

MPI_Win_wait.s: Completes an RMA exposure epoch started by a call to MPI_Win_post on win

MPI_Wtime.s: Returns an elapsed time on the calling processor.

MPI_Comm.s: Handle of a communicator: a group of processes and the context their messages are sent in.

MPI_Datatype.s: Handle of a datatype: the type and memory layout of the data an operation sends, receives or reads.

MPI_Errhandler.s: Handle of an error handler: what MPI does on an error in a communicator, window, file or session.

MPI_File.s: Handle of a file that MPI_File_open opened, for parallel input and output (MPI-IO).

MPI_Group.s: Handle of a group: an ordered set of processes, without a context to communicate in.

MPI_Info.s: Handle of an info object: a set of (key, value) hints passed to MPI.

MPI_Message.s: Handle of a message that MPI_Mprobe or MPI_Improbe matched, to receive with MPI_Mrecv or MPI_Imrecv.

MPI_Op.s: Handle of a reduction operation, such as MPI_SUM, or one that MPI_Op_create defines.

MPI_Request.s: Handle of a nonblocking or persistent operation, to complete with MPI_Wait or MPI_Test.

MPI_Session.s: Handle of an MPI session, which MPI_Session_init starts (MPI 4.0).

MPI_Status.s: Status of a receive or a completed request: its source, tag and error code.

MPI_Win.s: Handle of a window: memory that a process exposes to the one-sided operations of other processes.
